svg.text: the two-hole plate: the population an advisory number summarizes
512 Monte-Carlo samples, seed 0x4d435f4531315f31 — ADVISORY (E11.1): every number here is an estimate over draws, and none of it gates
study: hole spacing 3.10 mm ±0.05 mm (uniform), each radius 1.25 mm at σ = 0.01 mm — web = spacing − 2r, nominal 0.60 mm
web over the draws: mean 0.59682 mm, σ 0.05780 mm, range [0.48380, 0.73154] mm — 0.78% of draws fell outside the analyzed box
51 px/mm — all 512 samples are here, and the ±0.05 mm study is 5.1 px wide
294 px/mm — the same 512 samples, 73 px of cloud on a 0.60 mm web
blue: one stroke per sample per hole, at 0.03 opacity — each is a Surface::Cylinder read off the body that sample built
CERTIFIED: exact over a box, and silent outside it. The widest box that certifies THIS plate whole is 7.81e-7 of the study
— 2.3e-5 px at the right-hand panel's scale. A picture cannot show it, and that is the finding rather than a drawing problem.
ADVISORY: draws from the whole distribution, tail included. Its four numbers summarize these 512 plates — which is what the panel is.
